scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Ultra Time Patrol Battle reward evidence
verification_policy: Separate official content counts from community reward reports. Do not promote an artwork identity, drop rule, rank condition, or RNG behavior to verified without item-level evidence.

sources.scope: Confirms Ultra Time Patrol Battles and eight Chapter 4 loading-screen illustrations.
Community report that Super rank is associated with refusing offered boosts.
Community discussion reporting a single artwork as the reward, RNG behavior, and no separate no-boost reward.
Secondary wiki-style synthesis reporting artwork as the primary reward and that it can drop without Super rank.

records.name: Loading-screen artwork
records.official_context: Chapter 4 officially adds eight loading-screen illustrations and Ultra Time Patrol Battles.
records.reported_reward: One artwork from the Ultra Time Patrol Battle reward pool
records.rank_requirement: community reports indicate Super rank is not required; exact rule unresolved

records.name: Super rank
records.reported_condition: Complete the Ultra Time Patrol Battle run without accepting the offered boosts.
records.reward_dependency: Community evidence indicates Super rank is a challenge/rank outcome rather than a separate artwork reward requirement.

records.name: No separate reward for no-boost completion
records.claim: Community discussion reports that completing without boosts does not itself grant an additional reward beyond the artwork system.
records.evidence_limit: Not established by an official reward table.

important_identity_rules: Do not equate the eight Chapter 4 loading-screen illustrations with eight guaranteed Ultra Time Patrol Battle drops.
Do not assign a specific artwork number from the official eight-item count alone.
Do not treat Super rank as an artwork unlock requirement without item-level evidence.
Do not invent a numerical artwork drop rate from community reports that only describe RNG behavior.
Do not infer that every completion grants a different artwork or that the reward pool contains exactly eight entries.
research_targets: Identify the exact artwork inventory available from Ultra Time Patrol Battles.
Determine whether the reward is one fixed artwork, a pool, or multiple conditional pools.
Determine the exact rank/scoring formula and Super threshold.
Verify whether Super rank requires refusing every boost choice and whether any other action affects the rank.
Establish whether artwork acquisition is guaranteed, RNG-based, or subject to an additional condition.
Map any UTPB artwork rewards to the eight official Chapter 4 illustrations without conflating the broader Gallery of Time inventory.
